**Summary: 8 BLOCKER + 4 WARNING findings.**

The crate has fundamental design violations:

| Severity | Issue |
|---|---|
| BLOCKER | `MetricWorkflow` uses `status: String` + two `bool` lifecycle flags + `Option<u64>`, making illegal state combinations (e.g., sent without timestamp, sent without validation) representable and undetectable at compile time |
| BLOCKER | No enum-based typestate — status is a raw string allowing arbitrary values |
| BLOCKER | `id: String` is a primitive with no domain guard |
| BLOCKER | No smart constructor — any code can construct an invalid `MetricWorkflow` |
| BLOCKER | `mark_sent()` silently allows invalid transitions (sending unvalidated metrics) with no typed errors |
| BLOCKER | In-place mutation with `.to_string()` allocation instead of functional state transitions |
| WARNING | No benchmark/profiler/allocation/command evidence exists |

The core fix: replace the struct with an enum-based `MetricState` typestate (`Pending` → `Validated` → `Sent`) with data inside variants, smart constructors, and `Result`-typed transitions.
